Filter connected triangle components by minimum size

Source: R/filterMeshComponents.R
filterMeshComponents.Rd

Selects connected components according to their number of triangles, returning only the indices of the retained triangles.

Usage

filterMeshComponents(comps, minSize = 1000)

Arguments

comps

List of integer vectors containing triangle indices, typically returned by splitTrianglesInd().

minSize

Minimum number of triangles required to retain a component. If NULL, all components are retained. Default is 1000.

Value

Integer vector containing the indices of the retained triangles.

Examples

# Three connected components containing 5, 2 and 4 triangles
components <- list(1:5, 6:7, 8:11)

# Retain components with at least 4 triangles
filtered <- filterMeshComponents(comps = components, minSize = 4)

# Show retained triangle indices
filtered
#> [1]  1  2  3  4  5  8  9 10 11
